2025-MD2288.txt: A snow squall may develop in the next couple of hours, and progress across portions of the Ohio Valley into the northern Appalachians through evening. A sudden onset of moderate to heavy snow and 15-30 mph sustained northwesterly surface winds (with higher gusts) will create hazardous driving conditions, including reduced visibility.

2026-MD0087.txt: Locally damaging wind and/or a tornado remain possible through the remainder of the afternoon.
2026-MD0089.txt: Weak convective showers may pose a threat for waterspouts and damaging winds along portions of the southern California coast through mid-morning.
2026-MD0090.txt: A couple of strong to severe gusts are possible with high-based storms this evening and perhaps early tonight.
